question: Consider the following two statements: $P$: all cyclic quadrilaterals $ABCD$ satisfy $\tan\frac A2\tan\frac B2\tan\frac C2\tan\frac D2=1$, $Q$: all trapeziums $ABCD$ satisfy $\tan\frac A2\tan\frac B2\tan\frac C2\tan\frac D2=1$. Then

options.B: $P$ is true but $Q$ is not true
options.C: $P$ is not true and $Q$ is true
